entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's almost time. Were you able to sleep[n]last night?
I slept pretty well.
Not really...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Haha, I'm impressed. Whatever happens,[n]you always manage to just shake it off.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You're finally facing off against your[n]archenemy. I know you know this,[n]but don't get impatient...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Haha. I guess it must be hard,[n]even for you.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Now that we know who's behind it all,[n]we can't get hasty. Rushing will just[n]make us sloppy.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But geez, it's been getting cold lately.[n]We might freeze to death before we[n]can change his heart.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's look to see if we can find anything[n]to help us get warm.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: A heater, huh? Oh, this is good...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's so warm...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Once we take care of Shido...
What's wrong?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hm? Well...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Sorry. I don't mean to be[n]a downer...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I was just thinking... This might be the[n]last job for the Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If we defeat Shido, then Futaba and[n]Haru will avenge their parents.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We'll finally pay Shido back for setting[n]that trap to get us Phantom Thieves...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: More importantly, there'll be no more[n]mental shutdowns. And you'll finally[n]settle the score with him.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Everyone's goals and ambitions...[n]They're all linked to taking down[n]Shido. That's how I feel.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We all became phantom thieves for[n]our own reasons. We weren't just[n]playing around.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Outside of the Phantom Thieves, you[n]also have friends who've been helping[n]you. They believe in you.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We have an important battle ahead of[n]us, and we only made it all this way[n]because of them.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There's no guarantees we'll make it out[n]of this. [clr 2]See them as much as you can[clr 27] so[n]you have no regrets.
All right, I understand.
Don't jinx us by saying that!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Haha, you're right.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Then again, you didn't die, even though[n]you were killed, right? The others are[n]tough too!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: [fName]... I'm with you, all the way[n]to the end.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This upcoming battle is personal, so[n]we'll do it your way. Now you can fight[n]Shido on your terms!
